_brief: Tal 2026-10-03, item 6 Homeless 2, Option 2: "very visual/emotional. Fast cuts of the interaction, punch-ins on his face, him receiving/eating the food, then slower emotional moments. (erez V1 - MAKE SURE people are NOT passing by)". Then, later the same day: "stop with all the zooms its weird" (LESSONS 80) - so NO punch-ins, no snap zooms, no drift: every beat is the full frame at constant z=1, hard cuts and slow motion only. Time only moves forward. Sound: one continuous location-ambience bed (bedOnly) built from quiet stretches of the same clip (476-489.5, 526.5-536.5), with his real voice laid in for the one captioned line (makebed.py in this folder; rebuild the bed whenever a beat length changes). Every span was checked on full frames for passers-by.
beats: OPEN: Tal at the folding table, the man on the pavement reaches for the food (out before the blue shirt that crosses at 7.9)
SLOW-MO x0.5: Tal lays the food out in front of him (in after the passer-by on the left edge until 9.6)
he watches the table fill up, then smiles up at Tal (16.5)
CUT, at the table with Tal: his big smile, Tal raises his water (between passers-by at 62-64.0 and 67.5)
SLOW-MO x0.5: the two of them drink water together (clean 77-87)
CUT, reverse angle: Tal laughing with him (after the soldier behind at 507-509.1)
the one line, his real voice: "Don t give up." (clean 558.25-561.9; an arm crosses at 562.0)
SLOW-MO x0.5: he drinks, head back
CUT, close two-shot (IMG_9280, later the same afternoon): talking with Tal (after the woman behind them at 0-1.0)
ENDING, SLOW-MO x0.5: he turns to Tal - the slow hold
